task: File parse via public read API (heif_context_read_from_file) of an 'iref' entry that lists the same to_item_ID repeatedly (e.g. an 'iovl'/'dimg' placing one input image at two offsets, HEIF conformance file C021); feature removes Box_iref::check_for_double_references so repeated references parse. Core change libheif/box.cc (+4/-29) + box.h decl (rest tests). Injected-defect guess CWE-787/CWE-400 (dimg/iovl amplification or OOB).
